title: Hanoi's Old Quarter
content:
Hoàn Kiếm Lake with the Turtle Tower on its islet, the streets of the Old Quarter north of it, and the stretch of railway where the line runs between the houses.

Demo day with no recorded route: only the stop itself is on the map, the way a trip looks when somebody brings photographs and no location history. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
